description: Tasks template for modernization plan. Generate this file alongside plan.md to track individual migration tasks.

tasks.description: Upgrade the ContosoUniversity project from .NET Framework 4.8 to .NET 10, migrating from ASP.NET MVC 5 (System.Web) to ASP.NET Core MVC, converting the project from legacy packages.config format to SDK-style .csproj, and replacing Web.config configuration with appsettings.json.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the ContosoUniversity ASP.NET MVC 5 application from .NET Framework 4.8 to .NET 10. This includes: (1) Convert the legacy .csproj and packages.config to SDK-style project format; (2) Replace System.Web-based ASP.NET MVC 5 with ASP.NET Core MVC on .NET 10; (3) Migrate Web.config connection strings and appSettings to appsettings.json using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration; (4) Update Entity Framework Core from 3.1 to the latest version compatible with .NET 10; (5) Update all NuGet packages to versions compatible with .NET 10; (6) Fix any breaking API changes introduced by the migration from System.Web to ASP.NET Core (e.g., HttpContext, routing, filters, bundling/minification, Global.asax to Program.cs/Startup). Note: System.Messaging (MSMQ) used in NotificationService.cs is not compatible with .NET 5+ and must be addressed - stub it out or replace with a compatible alternative during this task.
tasks.taskSummary: Successfully upgraded ContosoUniversity from .NET Framework 4.8 to .NET 10. Converted legacy .csproj + packages.config to SDK-style project targeting net10.0. Replaced Global.asax with Program.cs minimal hosting model. Migrated Web.config to appsettings.json. Replaced System.Web/ASP.NET MVC 5 with ASP.NET Core MVC. Updated EF Core from 3.1 to 9.0.5. Replaced System.Messaging (MSMQ) with thread-safe ConcurrentQueue in-memory stub. Migrated static assets to wwwroot. Updated controllers, views, and view imports for ASP.NET Core. Build succeeds with 0 errors.
